verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents its own plugin system. Functions are modular Python plugins that extend the instance, and Tools, Functions, Pipes, Filters and Pipelines run as Python on the user's own self-hosted server. Per-version plugin-API migration guides indicate a maintained, documented format. missing for 10: explicit evidence of the load/import workflow (e.g. adding code via the admin UI or file upload), a detailed format spec (required class/method structure), and independent hands-on corroboration of writing and loading a custom plugin.

support.subject: As a developer, I can write my own skill, tool, or plugin against a documented format and load it into my instance locally

citations.quote: Functions are modular Python plugins that extend the capabilities of Open WebUI itself.
Tools, Functions, Pipes, Filters, and Pipelines execute arbitrary Python code on your server.
If you can write it in Python, you can turn it into a Function.
Extend with Python. Share what you build, run what others share.
publishes per-version plugin-API migration guides for breaking releases
